scoring_model.why: A transparent, reproducible way to rank the three products for content effort — with every input traceable to a verified field or explicitly marked as operator-set weight.
scoring_model.formula: content_priority = 0.35*verified_spec_completeness + 0.25*price_point_clarity + 0.20*differentiation + 0.20*brand_review_depth (each input 0-5, weights are operator-set and sum to 1)
scoring_model.note: Only 'verified_spec_completeness' and 'brand_review_depth' are computed from verified data. 'differentiation' is a judgement call. 'price_point_clarity' is 0 for all three because no Amazon price is verifiable — so the score is a planning aid only.

price_point_clarity.basis: No verifiable Amazon price (I-10); manufacturer page shows a discount ladder, not one price (I-9)

differentiation.basis: Dual independent baskets with Sync Finish is a genuinely distinct configuration vs the other two links

campaign_playbook.note: Operational design. Every control below is mapped to a verified compliance row in compliance.json so the automation cannot drift out of policy.

pipeline.name: Niche scoring
pipeline.automation: Recompute niche scores from the manufacturer catalogue + category pages monthly.
pipeline.control: N3 stays blank until a licensed keyword-volume source is added.

pipeline.name: Product ingestion
pipeline.automation: Pull ASIN, title, category and images via Creators API GetItems / SearchItems.
pipeline.control: Creators API requires ≥10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days (C19). Until then ingestion is manual and every field must carry a source URL.

pipeline.name: Price & availability
pipeline.automation: Only render price if it is served by Amazon or fetched through the API.
pipeline.control: C8 — this is why the site currently stores no prices.

pipeline.name: Content generation
pipeline.automation: Templated long-form from verified spec fields + original commentary.
pipeline.control: C10 (no hands-on claims) and C20 (original content). Specs are quoted and attributed.

pipeline.name: Link injection
pipeline.automation: Rewrite every outbound URL with the operator's tag plus a per-placement sub-tag.
pipeline.control: C7 — the build step FAILS if any outbound link lacks a tag= parameter once MONETISE=1 is set.

pipeline.name: Disclosure injection
pipeline.automation: Insert the disclosure block immediately above every link block.
pipeline.control: C1–C6. Build fails if a page has an outbound Amazon link and no disclosure element.

pipeline.name: Click tracking
pipeline.automation: First-party click events on outbound links, per sub-tag.
pipeline.control: No dynamic per-user sub-tags — the operating agreement forbids associating a sub-tag with a specific end user (C7 family).

pipeline.name: Conversion reconciliation
pipeline.automation: Match click counts to Associates reports ~24h after click (session rule) and again at 60-day payment run.

pipeline.name: Optimisation
pipeline.automation: Promote the placement with the highest verified conversion-per-click; retire dead placements.
pipeline.control: Only first-party aggregate data is used; no scraping of Amazon pages.

pipeline.name: Compliance re-audit
pipeline.automation: Nightly diff of affiliate-program.amazon.com policy pages; open a change ticket on any diff.
pipeline.control: Policy pages are versioned with an 'Updated' date — currently Policies 2026-04-14 and Agreement 2025-10-15.

kpis_that_can_be_measured_today: Number of verified spec fields per product (currently 18 / 16 / 18 of 20)
Number of rows without an official source (target: 0 — currently met for every published row)
Number of outbound links without a tracking tag (currently 3 of 3 — blocked on the operator, see I-2)
kpis_that_cannot_be_measured_yet: Commission per conversion — the category rate card is behind sign-in (C23)
Amazon star rating / review count — review pages require sign-in (I-11)
Best Sellers Rank — not exposed publicly (I-12)
